meta.title: Mia · Discord bot for Fortnite
meta.description: Mia is the Discord bot for Fortnite: manage Epic accounts, Battle Royale and Save the World, alerts, TaxiBots, public API, Premium, and tools like Spirits, Admin Panel, and Mia Launcher.

hero.title: Mia, your Fortnite bot
hero.subtitle: Available on Discord and Telegram
hero.lead: Manage your account, automate STW, check alerts, use TaxiBots, and power your server with feeds, commands, and Mia’s public API.
hero.trust: Trusted by recognized community creators and available in multiple languages, so anyone can use it without barriers.

features.title: Features
features.lead: What Mia offers for your Fortnite account and Discord server.

auto.title: Automation systems
auto.body: Manage AutoKick, free llamas, expeditions, recycling, and more from /configuraciones. Toggle each system and sync across all your accounts.

locker.title: Generate your Fortnite locker
locker.body: With /locker you get a filtered locker image, estimated V-Bucks and euro value, plus exclusives or Crew items.

alerts.title: Today’s STW alerts
alerts.body: Use /alertas ver to see today’s missions: V-Bucks, rewards, zones, and modifiers—just like in Discord.

feeds.title: Mia feeds on your server
feeds.body: With /config feed lista you set up daily V-Bucks, shop, supercharger, and more—with channel, role, and delivery type.

security.title: Security panel
security.body: One of Mia’s top systems: /seguridad detects unknown auths, 2FA changes, V-Bucks spending, and external connections.

server.title: Server settings
server.body: With /config servidor (server owner) you set Mia’s language, the premium image footer, and your Discord invite.
